form_inputs.do_not_regress_rules:
Nested patch_boundary.allowed_paths must populate validated_files and protected_paths in the freeze form.
owning_box must populate primary_box when primary_box is absent.
feature_type must populate box_type when box_type is absent.
summary must populate notes and freeze_warning must populate known_warnings.
protected_architecture_characteristics must populate feature-specific do-not-regress rules.
Legacy saved freeze-hint records with blank or placeholder form_inputs must be repaired from the raw hint.
Confirm/write readiness must require mandatory non-placeholder freeze fields, including validated_files.
Recognizable validation evidence must not be discarded merely because it contains the words safe starter fallback.
The repair must stay inside freeze_hint_intake plus tests and must not alter freeze_after_update_gui or local_freeze_writer logic.
Project-specific frozen memory must remain under project_freeze_after_update/frozen_features_memory.
Do not store project-specific frozen memory inside project_freeze_ledger.
Preview Freeze Entry must remain read-only and must not write files.
Confirm and Write must require explicit human confirmation before writing governed freeze memory.
After a local freeze write, the AI startup freeze context must be refreshed.
External AI review remains advanced/fallback, not the normal local freeze path.
